<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that matches the forward Doebner modification: an aromatic aldehyde plus malonic acid gives an α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid. In the forward direction an aldehyde and a carboxylic acid are consumed (broken) and a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic acid are formed. Using the available functional‑group names we query with “aldehydes” and “aliphatic carboxylic acid” as broken groups and both “C‑C double bonds” and “aliphatic carboxylic acid” as formed groups.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
